variants.name: b5-verification
variants.description: Deterministic QA receipt for reversible skill configuration reconciliation, provenance safety, cold restart, and fail-safe behavior

notes: Reserved dynamic filesystem entries cold-reload as api while configuration entries reload as fs-skills.
Four child processes reopened one SurrealKV directory for add, change, tombstone, and restore while preserving scoped configuration.
API-created and builtin skills survived empty-source reconciliation; ignoring provider_id failed the API assertion.
The empty-source fail-safe preserved the catalogue; removing it failed its exact assertion.
Tier 0 and strict OpenSpec validation passed; phase-level Tier 2 was not run.
